dedupe_keys.name: generation and emission data for main power plants in germany 2015 2021 unit identifier crosswalk

description: This data set gives unit-level generation and installation-level emission data for the main power plants in Germany from 2015 to 2021. It was published on Zenodo in November 2022 by Tim Niclas Schubert, Gabriel Avenmarg, Jan Frederick Unnewehr and Mirko Schäfer, with analysis code said to be on GitHub. A blocks workbook matches each generation unit's ENTSO-E EIC code to the Bundesnetzagentur BNA-ID and Marktstammdatenregister number and to the EU emissions trading installation ID, with location, name, block, electrical and heat capacity and fuel from the Bundesnetzagentur and Umweltbundesamt lists. Yearly generation per unit is computed from ENTSO-E unit time series, and per installation the verified ETS emissions are split into power and heat using free allocations, giving installation emission factors and utilisation factors. Coverage is German main power plants. The data are Excel workbooks in a zipped archive of about 94 KB, downloadable from Zenodo under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. Caveats: the heat split rests on stated assumptions about free allocations, and some installations lack results. Simulation uses are linking ENTSO-E, Bundesnetzagentur and emissions registers at unit level for plant-level power system models. Related records: model-powerplantmatching also harmonises power plant lists.
